toes.neutral_query_geometry: exact exported float32 skin; original lab coordinates and section/rig targets unchanged

original_skin_query.boundary: Signs on a self-intersecting surface are inferred multi-ray parity labels, not validated volumetric ground truth. Ray disagreement and proximity to known intersecting triangles mark local ambiguity; this band is a declared heuristic exclusion region, not proof that every ambiguity has been found. No surface repair, convex-hull replacement, or bone shrinking is performed. Use original-triangle queries for final checks; grid values are optimizer approximations.

selection.rule: largest face-connected component by measured surface area
selection.description: Exact input triangles only. Excluded components are not assumed anatomical organs.

self_intersections.triangle_index_space: selected component face indices; no repair or simplification

surface_audit.backend: Open3D RaycastingScene triangle distance; float32 queries
surface_audit.signed_convention: negative inside, positive outside; omitted when validity checks fail
surface_audit.scope: Distances and any signed result are relative to selected component, not excluded components.

original_skin_query.sign_semantics: negative inside under majority ray parity, positive outside
ambiguity_rules: one or more rays disagree with the majority inside/outside vote
distance to any known self-intersecting triangle <= uncertainty_band_m
original_skin_query.distance_backend: Open3D RaycastingScene.compute_distance on original selected triangles

selected_original_component.rule: largest face-connected component by measured surface area
selected_original_component.description: Exact input triangles only. Excluded components are not assumed anatomical organs.

derived_positive_coverage.birth_face_index_space: original selected component, never full input face IDs
derived_positive_coverage.query_coordinates: original float64 query points and ALL stored float64 union triangles; no float32 query scene
derived_positive_coverage.query_engine: cached igl.AABB.squared_distance plus ordinary igl.winding_number batch hierarchy
derived_positive_coverage.invalid_winding_policy: ambiguous and conservative exterior sign; original nonfinite winding retained as diagnostic

preflight.intersection_authority: CGAL EPECK original-face IF on stored coordinates

stored_coordinate_intersections.pair_index_space: original supplied derived faces, before remeshing
stored_coordinate_intersections.exact_decisions_scope: supplied stored float64 and float32-promoted coordinates, not unrounded Boolean output

float64_self_pair_search.scope: Same Open3D0.19 floating self-intersection predicate and original adjacency policy; no anatomical or exact-contact certificate

float32_self_pair_search.scope: Same Open3D0.19 floating self-intersection predicate and original adjacency policy; no anatomical or exact-contact certificate

birth_geometry.float32_allowance: measured vertex conversion norm and birth-plane barycentric gradients
